instruction:
Design a system that incorporates a 4-to-1 multiplexer and a 16-bit shift register. The 4-to-1 multiplexer should have an active-low enable input and five inputs (A, B, C, D, and EN) and one output (Y). If EN is low, Y should be low. If EN is high, Y should be equal to A if SEL is 00, B if SEL is 01, C if SEL is 10, and D if SEL is 11. The 16-bit shift register should have a parallel load input, synchronous reset input, clock enable input, and an output. The output should be the shifted data from the shift register. 

To implement this system, you will need an additional control logic module that takes in the output of the 4-to-1 multiplexer and the parallel load input to determine whether to load the shift register or shift the data. The control logic module should enable the shift register to shift the data when the clock enable input is high, and load the data from the parallel load input when the load input is high. The output of the shift register should be connected to the output of the system.
